description: Dot net core build checking tool.
releaseNotes:
﻿### Added
- Build check - MustNotDisableUnexpectedWarnings now also checks Directory.Build.props/targets and imported files, and flags WarningsNotAsErrors; new checks MustNotDisableAnalyzers, MustNotSuppressInSource (assembly/module SuppressMessage, GlobalSuppressions.cs) and MustNotDowngradeGlobalConfig (.globalconfig severity downgrades); TreatWarningsAsErrors and analysis properties are now also verified in imported files (#486)
- Check refusing explicit Microsoft.DotNet.ILCompiler package references (#492)
- Build check - added a --self-test switch that starts the app, builds the service provider and resolves all checks without doing any work, so a broken install can be spotted quickly (exit 0 on success, exit 1 with a one-line reason on stderr on failure), and a --help/-h switch to show usage (#496)
### Changed
- Tests - CanCheckOverrideTests now run the production check registrations instead of hand-copied checks (#480)
- Tests - Private async test helpers return ValueTask instead of Task (#479)
- IncludeAssets policy overrides and tests for Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience and Microsoft.Extensions.Telemetry.Abstractions (duplicate LoggerMessage generator, #462)
- Dependencies - Updated Nullable.Extended.Analyzer to 1.19.0
- Dependencies - Updated FunFair.Test to 6.4.7.2960
- Dependencies - Updated FunFair.Test.Source.Generator to 6.4.7.2960
- Dependencies - Updated Credfeto.Version.Information.Generator to 1.0.142.1766
- Dependencies - Updated Credfeto.Enumeration to 1.2.158.2511
- Dependencies - Updated FunFair.CodeAnalysis to 7.2.25.2636
- Dependencies - Updated xunit.analyzers to 2.3.0

- SDK - Updated DotNet SDK to 11.0.100
